title.text: What if you lived alone in the mountains?

lines.l02: Breakfast takes as long as you want.
lines.l03: You grow most of what you eat.
lines.l04: Something walked past while you slept.
lines.l05: Nobody else knows this place exists.
lines.l08: No power. No signal. No problem.
lines.l09: You stay warm with what you gathered.
lines.l10: Storms pass. Views like this stay.
lines.l12: No boss. No traffic. No stress.
